title: Klammerdiagramm — vanāntaram (X-antara)
desc: Leitan's mayūravyaṃsakādi / X-antara idiom vanāntaram (anyad vanam — another forest): an ordinary right-to-left directed pair, exceptionless bracket; the idiomatic 'other' sense is semantics, not structure (MG vote D3). I/II часть omitted (notation demo).
